claim_boundary: All newly generated observations are software or shadow evidence unless an external execution manifest identifies physical hardware and an independent operator.
A local simulator, PyBullet DIRECT run, replayed sensor trace, or QEMU run is not independent third-party assessment or physical HIL.
Learned output may add caution or request confirmation. It may not grant permission, remove a deterministic block, execute an actuator command, or expand a capability.
The study is diagnostic and cannot promote or replace a deployed artifact. A separate frozen promotion protocol would be required after all runtime and authority gates pass.

settings.checkpoint_rule: lowest validation Gaussian negative log likelihood; every method completes the full fixed update budget
